name: Simple rule with the Interloper taking 0.25
strategy: The simple refill rule ($0 of model spend), with the Interloper next door taking 0.25 of the demand for a drink it also sells at our price (more when we are dearer), and 0.4 of that from energy drinks
source: PR #154 (branch sim_interloper, 1ad218a): docs/simulations/2026-11-16-interloper.md. Only the totals were kept; the seasons' data wasn't archived
notes: Nobody can see the Interloper's sales, so the share it takes is a guess; the sweep shows the range.
Most of the loss is energy drinks (Red Bull and Celsius), not the cans it sells head to head.
This models customers only. Our pricing never uses the Interloper's prices (docs/agent/interloper.md).
Weekly figures, decisions and the season's slots weren't kept. Rerun it to get them (docs/simulations.md).
